name: Ange's Rant
tagline: Funk. Soul. Disco. Made to keep you movin'.
shortBio: Groove-based sounds from Melbourne — funk and soul with a splash of disco/pop and an 80's flavour. Always quirky, always fun, with one mission: keeping you movin'.
bio: Ange's Rant is the brainchild of Angelo Pisano, a bass player from Melbourne, Australia. After many years holding down the low end in cover bands, Ange decided it was time to pay homage to the artists that shaped his musical journey — and to do it his way.
The result is groove-based music that touches on funk, soul and disco/pop with an unmistakable 80's flavour. It's quirky, it's fun, and it's built from the ground up to keep you movin'.
The debut digital album, Another Time, is a 13-track release made possible by the creative contribution and skills of Ange's talented musician friends.
